question: In MS Excel 2019, what is the primary purpose of the 'Print Preview' feature?

options.text: To view how the sheet will look when printed

solution:
The correct answer is __**To view how the sheet will look when printed**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The 'Print Preview' feature in MS Excel 2019 allows users to **see exactly how their spreadsheet will appear when printed**, ensuring proper layout and formatting.
 
• It is accessed through the **File tab → Print** or by using the shortcut **Ctrl + P**.
 
• The feature provides options to adjust settings such as **page orientation, margins, scaling, and paper size** directly from the preview window.
 
• Users can check for errors like **truncated columns, misaligned rows, or missing data** before printing.
 
• It helps save paper and ink by avoiding unnecessary printing of incorrectly formatted sheets.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Page Layout:**

 
 
• The 'Page Layout' tab in MS Excel provides options to adjust page settings, including margins, orientation, and scaling.
 
• These settings directly impact how the content appears in the 'Print Preview' window.
 
 
 
• **Scaling Options:**
 
 
• Users can fit the spreadsheet to one page or multiple pages using scaling options in the 'Print Preview' screen.
 
• This ensures that large datasets are printed in an organized and readable format.
 
 
 
• **Headers and Footers:**
 
 
• The 'Print Preview' feature allows users to view headers and footers before printing, ensuring that important information like page numbers or titles is included.
 
 
 
• **Print Settings:**
 
 
• In the 'Print Preview' window, users can customize settings such as the number of copies, printer selection, and page range to print.
 
 
 
• **Shortcut for Quick Access:**
 
 
• The keyboard shortcut **Ctrl + P** opens the print preview directly, speeding up the printing process.
